functions.name: get_org_admin_before_owned_roles_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.get_org_admin_before_owned_roles_v1(p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
with department_rows as (
  select
    d.id,
    d.name,
    d.code,
    coalesce(d.depth, 0) as depth,
    coalesce(d.member_count, 0) as member_count,
    d.parent_id,
    parent.name as parent_name,
    d.leader_id,
    leader.display_name as leader_name,
    coalesce(d.sort_order, 0) as sort_order
  from departments d
  left join departments parent
    on parent.id = d.parent_id
   and coalesce(parent.status, 'active') = 'active'
  left join users leader
    on leader.id = d.leader_id
   and coalesce(leader.status, 'active') <> 'inactive'
  where d.org_id = p_org_id
    and coalesce(d.status, 'active') = 'active'
),
space_rows as (
  select
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.description,
    s.department_id,
    d.name as department_name,
    s.owner_id
  from sales_spaces s
  left join departments d
    on d.id = s.department_id
   and coalesce(d.status, 'active') = 'active'
  where s.org_id = p_org_id
),
org_memberships as (
  select
    uo.user_id,
    uo.org_id,
    uo.status,
    uo.primary_department_id,
    uo.employment_status
  from user_organizations uo
  where uo.org_id = p_org_id
    and uo.status in ('invited', 'active', 'suspended')
),
user_rows as (
  select
    u.id,
    u.email,
    u.display_name,
    u.title,
    u.status,
    u.must_change_password,
    coalesce(m.primary_department_id, u.primary_dept_id) as primary_dept_id,
    u.login_enabled,
    u.report_to_user_id,
    u.created_at,
    m.status as membership_status,
    m.employment_status,
    pd.name as primary_dept_name,
    manager.display_name as report_to_user_name
  from users u
  join org_memberships m on m.user_id = u.id
  left join departments pd
    on pd.id = coalesce(m.primary_department_id, u.primary_dept_id)
   and coalesce(pd.status, 'active') = 'active'
  left join users manager on manager.id = u.report_to_user_id
),
current_role_rows as (
  select
    ur.user_id,
    ur.scope_type,
    ur.scope_id,
    ur.granted_at,
    r.id as role_id,
    r.name as role_name,
    r.code as role_code,
    coalesce(r.sort_order, 0) as sort_order,
    case
      when ur.scope_type = 'department' then coalesce(d.name, '部门')
      when ur.scope_type = 'space' then coalesce(s.name, '销售空间')
      else '组织'
    end as scope_name
  from user_roles ur
  join roles r on r.id = ur.role_id
  left join departments d
    on ur.scope_type = 'department'
   and d.id = ur.scope_id
   and d.org_id = p_org_id
   and coalesce(d.status, 'active') = 'active'
  left join sales_spaces s
    on ur.scope_type = 'space'
   and s.id = ur.scope_id
   and s.org_id = p_org_id
  where ur.org_id = p_org_id
    and ur.user_id in (select id from user_rows)
    and (
      (ur.scope_type = 'org' and (ur.scope_id is null or ur.scope_id = p_org_id))
      or (ur.scope_type = 'department' and d.id is not null)
      or (ur.scope_type = 'space' and s.id is not null)
    )
),
role_payload as (
  select
    crr.user_id,
    coalesce(
      string_agg(
        case
          when crr.scope_type = 'org' then crr.role_name
          else crr.role_name || '(' || crr.scope_name || ')'
        end,
        ', '
        order by crr.sort_order, crr.role_name, crr.scope_name
      ),
      ''
    ) as role_names,
    coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(crr.role_id order by crr.sort_order, crr.role_name)
        filter (where crr.scope_type = 'org'),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) as role_ids,
    coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(crr.role_code order by crr.sort_order, crr.role_name)
        filter (where crr.scope_type = 'org'),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) as role_codes,
    coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'roleId', crr.role_id,
          'roleName', crr.role_name,
          'roleCode', crr.role_code,
          'scopeType', crr.scope_type,
          'scopeId', crr.scope_id,
          'scopeName', crr.scope_name,
          'grantedAt', crr.granted_at
        )
        order by crr.sort_order, crr.role_name, crr.scope_name
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) as scoped_roles
  from current_role_rows crr
  group by crr.user_id
)
select jsonb_build_object(
  'organization',
  (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'id', o.id,
      'name', o.name,
      'slug', o.slug
    )
    from organizations o
    where o.id = p_org_id
    limit 1
  ),
  'users',
  coalesce(
    (
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', u.id,
          'email', coalesce(u.email, ''),
          'display_name', u.display_name,
          'title', coalesce(u.title, ''),
          'primary_dept_id', u.primary_dept_id,
          'primary_dept_name', coalesce(u.primary_dept_name, '-'),
          'role_names', coalesce(rp.role_names, ''),
          'role_ids', coalesce(rp.role_ids, '[]'::jsonb),
          'role_codes', coalesce(rp.role_codes, '[]'::jsonb),
          'scoped_roles', coalesce(rp.scoped_roles, '[]'::jsonb),
          'status', u.status,
          'membership_status', u.membership_status,
          'employment_status', u.employment_status,
          'must_change_password', coalesce(u.must_change_password, false),
          'login_enabled', coalesce(u.login_enabled, true),
          'report_to_user_id', u.report_to_user_id,
          'report_to_user_name', u.report_to_user_name
        )
        order by u.created_at desc nulls last
      )
      from user_rows u
      left join role_payload rp on rp.user_id = u.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ),
  'departments',
  coalesce(
    (
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', d.id,
          'name', d.name,
          'code', d.code,
          'depth', d.depth,
          'member_count', d.member_count,
          'parent_id', d.parent_id,
          'parent_name', d.parent_name,
          'leader_id', d.leader_id,
          'leader_name', d.leader_name
        )
        order by d.depth, d.sort_order, d.name
      )
      from department_rows d
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ),
  'roles',
  coalesce(
    (
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', r.id,
          'code', r.code,
          'name', r.name
        )
        order by coalesce(r.sort_order, 0), r.name
      )
      from roles r
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ),
  'spaces',
  coalesce(
    (
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', s.id,
          'name', s.name,
          'description', s.description,
          'department_id', s.department_id,
          'department_name', coalesce(s.department_name, ''),
          'owner_id', s.owner_id
        )
        order by s.name
      )
      from space_rows s
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
);
$function$

functions.name: has_exact_org_role_v1
functions.arguments: p_user_id uuid, p_org_id uuid, p_code text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_exact_org_role_v1(p_user_id uuid, p_org_id uuid, p_code text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.user_roles as grant_row
    join public.roles as role on role.id = grant_row.role_id
    where grant_row.user_id = p_user_id and grant_row.org_id = p_org_id
      and grant_row.scope_type = 'org' and grant_row.scope_id = p_org_id and role.code = p_code
  );
$function$

functions.name: org_role_catalog_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.org_role_catalog_v1(p_org_id uuid, p_include_archived boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code text, name text, description text, permissions jsonb, sort_order integer, owner_org_id uuid, archived_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, role_revision bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select definition.id, definition.code, coalesce(metadata.name, definition.name),
    case when metadata.role_id is null then definition.description else metadata.description end,
    definition.permissions, definition.sort_order, definition.owner_org_id, metadata.archived_at,
    definition.created_at, coalesce(metadata.role_revision, 0)
  from public.organizations as organization
  join public.roles as definition on definition.owner_org_id is null or definition.owner_org_id = organization.id
  left join private.org_role_metadata as metadata on metadata.org_id = organization.id and metadata.role_id = definition.id
  where organization.id = p_org_id and organization.status = 'active'
    and (p_include_archived or metadata.archived_at is null);
$function$

functions.name: org_role_is_referenced_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.org_role_is_referenced_v1(p_org_id uuid, p_role_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.user_roles as binding where binding.org_id = p_org_id and binding.role_id = p_role_id)
    or exists (select 1 from public.fxiaoke_pending_org_roles as pending
      where pending.org_id = p_org_id and pending.role_id = p_role_id)
    or exists (select 1 from public.personnel_invitations as invitation
      where invitation.org_id = p_org_id and invitation.status = 'pending' and p_role_id = any(invitation.role_ids));
$function$

functions.name: org_super_admin_active_member_v1

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.org_super_admin_active_member_v1(p_user_id uuid, p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.user_organizations as membership
    join public.users as person on person.id = membership.user_id
    where membership.user_id = p_user_id and membership.org_id = p_org_id
      and membership.is_default and membership.status = 'active'
      and membership.employment_status = 'active' and membership.left_at is null
      and person.status = 'active' and person.login_enabled = true
  );
$function$

functions.name: personnel_is_org_control_admin_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.personnel_is_org_control_admin_v1(p_user_id uuid, p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean

functions.name: reject_fxiaoke_baseline_invitation_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.reject_fxiaoke_baseline_invitation_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if exists (select 1 from public.roles where id = any(new.role_ids) and code = 'FXIAOKE_BASELINE') then
    raise exception 'the historical baseline role cannot be newly assigned'
      using errcode = '42501', detail = 'LEGACY_BASELINE_ASSIGNMENT_FORBIDDEN';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

admin_list_org_roles_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_list_org_roles_v1(p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, code text, name text, description text, permissions jsonb, sort_order integer, owner_org_id uuid, archived_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, role_revision bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select catalog.* from private.org_role_catalog_v1(p_org_id, false) as catalog

$function$

functions.name: fxiaoke_prelogin_role_targets_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fxiaoke_prelogin_role_targets_v1(p_org_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, source_id uuid, identity_id uuid, external_user_id text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select person.id, source.id, identity.id, identity.external_user_id
  from public.users person
  join public.user_organizations membership on membership.user_id = person.id and membership.org_id = person.org_id
  join public.organization_sources source on source.system_org_id = person.org_id and source.provider = 'fxiaoke'
  join public.external_identities identity on identity.system_org_id = person.org_id and identity.source_id = source.id
    and identity.canonical_user_id = person.id
  where person.org_id = p_org_id and (p_user_id is null or person.id = p_user_id)
    and person.status = 'inactive' and person.login_enabled = false
    and person.password_hash is null and person.last_login_at is null
    and membership.status = 'invited' and membership.employment_status = 'active' and membership.is_default
    and source.status = 'active' and source.connection_state = 'verified' and source.effective_revision is not null
    and source.authority_scope->>'identity' = 'authoritative' and source.authority_scope->>'directory' = 'authoritative'
    and identity.match_status = 'matched' and identity.external_user_id <> ''
    and identity.profile_snapshot->>'provisionedMemberId' = person.id::text
    and identity.profile_snapshot->>'status' = 'active'
    and identity.profile_snapshot->>'loginDisabled' is distinct from 'true'
    and identity.profile_snapshot->>'deleted' is distinct from 'true'
    -- An admin may explicitly disable an already inactive, never-logged-in account.
    -- Its current flags alone are identical to an untouched directory reservation.
    and not coalesce((
      select event.after_state->>'login_enabled' = 'false' or event.after_state->>'status' in ('inactive','suspended')
      from public.personnel_lifecycle_events event
      where event.org_id = p_org_id and event.target_user_id = person.id and event.command = 'set_account_state'
      order by event.occurred_at desc, event.id desc limit 1
    ), false)
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.organization_sources other
      where other.system_org_id = p_org_id and other.provider = 'fxiaoke' and other.id <> source.id
    )
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.external_identities other
      where other.source_id = source.id and other.canonical_user_id = person.id and other.id <> identity.id
        and other.match_status in ('matched', 'conflict')
    );
$function$

functions.name: get_org_admin_directory_payload_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_org_admin_directory_payload_v1(p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with base as (select public.get_org_admin_payload_v1(p_org_id) as payload),
  identities as (
    select external_identity.*, count(*) over (partition by source_id, canonical_user_id) as mapping_count
    from public.external_identities external_identity
    where system_org_id = p_org_id and match_status = 'matched'
  )
  select payload || jsonb_build_object(
    'users', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(person.value || jsonb_build_object(
      'primary_dept_name', coalesce((select dept.name from public.departments dept
        where dept.org_id = p_org_id and dept.id = nullif(person.value->>'primary_dept_id', '')::uuid), '-'),
      'department_ids', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(link.department_id order by link.is_primary desc, link.department_id)
        from public.user_departments link join public.departments dept on dept.id = link.department_id and dept.org_id = p_org_id
        where link.org_id = p_org_id and link.user_id = (person.value->>'id')::uuid), '[]'::jsonb),
      'secondary_dept_names', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(dept.name order by dept.name)
        from public.user_departments link join public.departments dept on dept.id = link.department_id and dept.org_id = p_org_id
        where link.org_id = p_org_id and link.user_id = (person.value->>'id')::uuid and not link.is_primary), '[]'::jsonb),
      'directory_identity_id', identity.id,
      'directory_external_id', identity.external_user_id,
      'directory_source', source.provider,
      'directory_status', membership.employment_status,
      'directory_pending_account', coalesce(identity.profile_snapshot->>'provisionedMemberId' = person.value->>'id'
        and (person.value->>'login_enabled')::boolean = false, false)
    ) order by person.ordinality)
    from jsonb_array_elements(payload->'users') with ordinality person(value, ordinality)
    join public.user_organizations membership on membership.org_id = p_org_id and membership.user_id = (person.value->>'id')::uuid
    left join public.organization_sources source on source.system_org_id = p_org_id and source.authority_scope->>'directory' in ('authoritative', 'true')
    left join identities identity on identity.source_id = source.id
      and identity.canonical_user_id = membership.user_id and identity.mapping_count = 1
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'departments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', dept.id, 'name', dept.name, 'code', dept.code, 'depth', dept.depth,
      'parent_id', dept.parent_id, 'parent_name', parent.name, 'member_count', dept.member_count,
      'source', dept.source, 'status', dept.status, 'external_id', dept.external_id,
      'leader_id', to_jsonb(dept)->>'leader_id', 'leader_name', leader.display_name
    ) order by dept.sort_order, dept.id)
    from public.departments dept
    left join public.departments parent on parent.id = dept.parent_id and parent.org_id = p_org_id
    left join public.users leader on leader.id = nullif(to_jsonb(dept)->>'leader_id', '')::uuid and leader.org_id = p_org_id
    where dept.org_id = p_org_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) from base;
$function$

functions.name: get_org_admin_directory_payload_v2
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_org_admin_directory_payload_v2(p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with base as (select public.get_org_admin_directory_payload_v1(p_org_id) as payload),
  targets as (select * from public.fxiaoke_prelogin_role_targets_v1(p_org_id)),
  pending as (
    select grant_row.user_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', role.id, 'code', role.code, 'name', role.name)
      order by role.name, role.id) as roles
    from public.fxiaoke_pending_org_roles as grant_row
    join public.admin_list_org_roles_v1(p_org_id) as role on role.id = grant_row.role_id
    join targets on targets.user_id = grant_row.user_id and targets.source_id = grant_row.source_id
      and targets.identity_id = grant_row.external_identity_id and targets.external_user_id = grant_row.external_user_id
    where grant_row.org_id = p_org_id group by grant_row.user_id
  )
  select base.payload || jsonb_build_object('users', coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(member.value || jsonb_build_object(
      'can_preassign_org_roles', targets.user_id is not null,
      'pending_org_roles', coalesce(pending.roles, '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by member.ordinality)
    from jsonb_array_elements(base.payload->'users') with ordinality as member(value, ordinality)
    left join targets on targets.user_id = (member.value->>'id')::uuid
    left join pending on pending.user_id = targets.user_id
  ), '[]'::jsonb)) from base;
$function$

functions.name: get_org_admin_payload_v1
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_org_admin_payload_v1(p_org_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with base as (select private.get_org_admin_before_owned_roles_v1(p_org_id) as payload),
  catalog as materialized (select * from public.admin_list_org_roles_v1(p_org_id))
  select base.payload || jsonb_build_object(
    'roles', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', role.id, 'code', role.code, 'name', role.name)
      order by coalesce(role.sort_order, 0), role.name, role.id) from catalog as role), '[]'::jsonb),
    'users', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(person.value || jsonb_build_object(
      'role_names', coalesce(bindings.role_names, ''),
      'role_ids', coalesce(bindings.role_ids, '[]'::jsonb),
      'role_codes', coalesce(bindings.role_codes, '[]'::jsonb),
      'scoped_roles', coalesce(bindings.scoped_roles, '[]'::jsonb)
    ) order by person.ordinality)
    from jsonb_array_elements(base.payload->'users') with ordinality as person(value, ordinality)
    cross join lateral (
      select string_agg(case when assignment.value->>'scopeType' = 'org' then role.name
        else role.name || '(' || (assignment.value->>'scopeName') || ')' end, ', ' order by assignment.ordinality) as role_names,
        jsonb_agg(role.id order by assignment.ordinality) filter (where assignment.value->>'scopeType' = 'org') as role_ids,
        jsonb_agg(role.code order by assignment.ordinality) filter (where assignment.value->>'scopeType' = 'org') as role_codes,
        jsonb_agg(assignment.value || jsonb_build_object('roleName', role.name) order by assignment.ordinality) as scoped_roles
      from jsonb_array_elements(person.value->'scoped_roles') with ordinality as assignment(value, ordinality)
      join catalog as role on role.id = (assignment.value->>'roleId')::uuid
    ) as bindings), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) from base;
$function$
